units.source_text: 自退出赤穗城已经有近两年的时光了，

en.t: Nearly two years had already passed since he withdrew from Ako Castle,

units.source_text: 他花费了大量心血去策划，很是焦虑。

en.t: He had poured enormous effort into planning it and was deeply anxious.

units.source_text: 就光是拦着那些急于求成、性格冲动的同伴，防止他们草率动手，静候成熟时机，

en.t: Even just holding back those impatient, impulsive companions, keeping them from acting rashly, and waiting quietly for the right moment,
his hardship was far beyond ordinary.

units.source_text: 此外，仇人派来的细作一直在偷窥他的一举一动。

en.t: Moreover, spies sent by his enemy were constantly watching his every move.

units.source_text: 他表面上放浪形骸，企图遮住这些细作的眼睛，

en.t: Outwardly he acted as if he had given himself over to dissipation, trying to deceive those spies,

units.source_text: 与此同时又一定得让自己的伙伴不要被自放浪的假象蒙蔽。

en.t: while at the same time he had to make sure his own comrades were not misled by the false appearance of his dissipation.

units.source_text: 他回忆过去自己在山科和圆山的计议，

en.t: He thought back on the plans he had once discussed at Yamashina and Maruyama,

units.source_text: 那时候说不出口的苦衷又在心头浮现。

en.t: and the painful feelings he could not voice then rose again in his heart.

units.source_text: 不过，现如今一切都已尘埃落定，目的已经实现了。

en.t: But now everything had been settled, and his purpose had already been achieved.
